title: Escalate an unresolved complaint
summary: Take an unresolved issue to the executive/complaints team with a clear resolution and a regulator fallback.
goal_default: The resolution I am seeking is: [state it clearly].

rights.claim: Executive / complaints teams resolve what front-line staff cannot.
rights.basis: Common corporate escalation structure (office of the president / executive relations).

rights.claim: A clear, dated summary of prior attempts strengthens the escalation.
Naming the specific regulator or ombudsman signals you are serious.
rights.basis: Availability of sector regulators / ombudsman schemes.

ladder: Formal complaint to the executive / complaints team

artifact.subject: Formal complaint — request for resolution
artifact.body:
To: {{target}} — Office of the President / Complaints

Hello,

Despite prior attempts, my issue remains unresolved. Summary: [what happened, dates, reference numbers].

{{goal}} Please respond within 7 business days. If it remains unresolved, I will file with the relevant regulator / ombudsman and share my experience publicly.

Sincerely,
{{name}}

disclaimer: This is information to help you write your own request. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
